text: The production send path filters the parsed address objects with filter(Boolean), whereas the collection unit-test adapter also filters on addr.email. In this boundary, do not describe object filtering as proof that every email is nonempty. This is a static contract limit; the header parser’s full input validation and a malformed-recipient send were not exercised. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Object filtering at address collection is not email validation
